dataset.name: WTC 1 V8Q constrained floor network-flow and null-space audit
dataset.scope: Use the V8P before/after axial-force intervals and official Floor 93-99 core totals to impose exact floor-by-floor nodal equilibrium on an explicit orthogonal core graph, then quantify structural non-uniqueness and test six geometry-selected columns withheld before solving.
dataset.warning: The force intervals remain digitized outputs of the NIST global model. Edge-flow variables are equilibrium bookkeeping variables, not calibrated beam, slab, connection, or explosive demands. Algebraic feasibility cannot validate a physical cold load path or an event mechanism.

model_hypotheses.nodal_balance: For each floor, after-load minus before-load equals the signed divergence of in-plane core-edge transfers plus an external floor/perimeter exchange on declared boundary columns.
model_hypotheses.orthogonal_adjacency: Connect consecutive identifiers within each 500-1000 row and equal terminal digits between consecutive rows, matching the V8L reconstructed orthogonal topology envelope.
model_hypotheses.external_ports: Allow one signed external exchange only on columns whose reconstructed x or y coordinate is at the core envelope minimum or maximum.
model_hypotheses.regularized_representative: Among infinitely many equilibrium flows, select the weighted minimum-quadratic-energy representative. Edge weights scale with reconstructed length; boundary-port weights are selected only by inner validation.
model_hypotheses.important_limit: No as-built floor membrane stiffness, connection force-displacement law, or edge capacity is assigned in V8Q. The selected flow is a mathematical gauge, not a mechanically identified force path.

reserved_validation.selection_rule: One surviving column from each reconstructed row, chosen before V8Q solving and distinct from the V8P reserved set.
reserved_validation.withheld_fields: All seven after-impact intervals for every reserved column are excluded from hyperparameter selection and final solving. Before-impact intervals, official totals, coordinates and topology remain available.

inner_validation.method: Leave one declared inner column out over Floors 93-99 while keeping all final reserved columns unavailable. Select lexicographically by mean distance outside its observed interval, midpoint MAE, maximum midpoint error, then parameter magnitude.

uncertainty_sampling.method: Deterministic uniform sampling inside every available digitization interval, followed by exact bounded projection of before-impact loads to the official total and a constrained solution for after-impact loads. Reserved after-impact values remain hidden.
